regret_definition: Realized stay-weighted loss minus the structural marginal reference loss.
generator_definition: x beta plus common time and latent individual trajectory, with triggered feedback and rounding applied before retaining sampled times.
conditioning: The reference does not condition the serial residual distribution on the realized early residual history.
informative_monitoring: The retained time set is generated from preceding observed MAP and latent level, with lower and upper count enforcement.
method_comparison: All published performance comparisons use paired losses of fitted forecasting rules; structural-reference regret is supplementary.
